fields.description: Which kinds of scan this site takes in. A kind switched off is not offered on the capture page, its uploads are refused, and an email sent to an account that captures it is discarded with a note saying why. Captures already made are kept.
fields.label: What This Site Captures

fields.description: A supplier's invoice, drafted as a Purchase Invoice.
fields.label: Purchase Invoices

fields.description: An employee's receipts, drafted as their own Expense Claim.
fields.label: Expense Claims

fields.description: Words that say what sort of company a name belongs to rather than which one, ignored when a scanned supplier or buyer is matched to this site's suppliers and companies. One per line, without punctuation. Added to the app's own list, which already has pvt, ltd, llc, inc, co, gmbh, sa, bv, pty, plc, ag, srl, oy, ab and as, among others.
fields.label: Extra Legal Words

fields.description: Added to the end of every prompt that reads a document (invoices, receipts, bank statements), for this site's own conventions: how its suppliers print their bills, a local tax or currency the reading should know about, a calendar or number format its documents use. Plain sentences, as you would tell a bookkeeper. Leave it empty if the documents read correctly without it.
fields.label: Additional Instructions

fields.description: What this site's documents call the tax registration number and the tax a buyer withholds from a payment. Leave them empty to use the terms of the company's country where the app knows them (Nepal, India), and plain "tax registration number" and "withholding tax" elsewhere.
fields.label: Tax Terms

fields.description: How many scans one person may have read in an hour. Every read is billed to the Claude key, at a few cents a page; a person working through a pile of scans needs about one a minute. 0 means no limit.
fields.label: Reads per Person per Hour
